plainTranslation: A's drive meets B's identity. The sextile supports them, if you act on it.
policy: Governed by synastry-policy. Descriptive, not deterministic; intensity is never treated as obligation, safety concerns override astrology.
note: Synced from authored synastry bundle synastry-authored__19_ (2).json.
summaryDeep: Their initiative, urgency, directness, and temper work smoothly with your sense of self, confidence, and direction. It runs easily and asks little, quietly steadying the rest of the bond. Lean on how naturally this one lines up.
tension: Because this energy is easygoing, it can be easy to overlook. You may not always notice how much you motivate each other until you compare it to relationships where nothing ever seems to move forward.
advice: The key is not to overthink it. Make the plan, send the text, take the first step. This connection tends to work best when the two of you are actually doing things together instead of just talking about them.
summaryShort: Their initiative, urgency, directness, and temper work smoothly with your sense of self, confidence, and direction.
